front.title: Mission Resource Access Profile for OAuth 2.0

abstract.t:
This document defines mission_resource_access, a general-purpose OAuth 2.0 Rich Authorization Requests (RAR) authorization_details type for Mission-Bound Authorization for OAuth 2.0 (the "issuance profile"). An entry names one resource, matched exactly or by path prefix; the actions permitted there, including wildcard action families; machine-actionable constraints, including a registered Common Constraints vocabulary; and a per-entry delegation policy.
The document also defines how two entries compare and narrow, how a resource server enforces an entry, when an entry can be projected to OAuth scope, and how an authorization server declares its support for these semantics. The issuance profile is type-agnostic: a deployment can support this type, another authorization_details type, or both.
